analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive session. RSI rose slightly from 35.3 to 40.2 but remains in neutral territory. analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price (83,940 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (81,393 KRW / 87,149 KRW / 98,689 KRW): Mixed diagnosis with short-term SMA5 breach but mid-term SMA20/50 rejection.
· Significant rejection below SMA100/200 (106,209 KRW / 100,863 KRW): Sustained weak long-term trend.

· MACD histogram trajectory (186.5383→-31.5934): Continued worsening reinforces the bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band 87,149 KRW): Trading around the mid-band, showing directional indecision.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance (89,550 KRW): A break above could signal a short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day high/low patterns: No clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed; confirmed sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.62): Subdued volume compared to the 5-day average reduces confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): Awaiting a trend-defining signal with accompanying volume.
